Okama Crater of Zao
miyagi.desc: Located on the border of Miyagi and Yamagata prefectures, the Zao Mountain Range has been selected as one of Japan’s 100 most famous mountains. Okama Crater is a crater-lake surrounded by three mountains (Kattadake, Kumanodake and Goshikidake) and, along with its frost-covered trees, is an iconic image of the Zao Mountains. Nicknamed the “Cauldron” because of its appearance, Okama Crater is also known locally as “Goshikinuma” (the five-coloured pond) thanks to the changing hues of the water from dark green to blue according to the sunlight. The colours of the crater-lake also fascinate visitors as they change depending on the angle of view. The lake is a kilometre in circumference, 325m in diameter, and has a depth of 27.6m. There is no life in the lake due to strong acidity of the water.

kyoto.title: Ine village  in summer
kyoto.desc: Welcome to the hidden gem of Ine, where the sea meets tranquility and natural beauty. Ine, a coastal town in Japan, has recently been designated as a national park due to its breathtaking scenery and crystal-clear waters. One of the most captivating aspects of this destination is its high transparency, which allows visitors to witness the marine life thriving beneath the surface. As you explore Ine, you'll notice a unique sight that sets it apart from other coastal towns - boat houses gracefully lining up along the shore. These traditional wooden structures not only add charm to the landscape but also offer an extraordinary opportunity for travelers. Imagine waking up to the gentle sounds of waves and being surrounded by panoramic views of the sea.

kyoto.title: Amanohashidate
kyoto.desc: Amanohashidate, often referred to as "Bridge to Heaven," is undeniably one of the three most picturesque spots in Japan. Located in the northern part of Kyoto Prefecture, Amanohashidate has captivated travelers from all over the world with its breathtaking beauty and tranquil atmosphere. This stunning sandbar stretches across the mouth of Miyazu Bay, connecting the two sides of the bay with a narrow strip of land covered in pine trees. The unique shape and natural beauty of Amanohashidate have earned it a well-deserved reputation as one of Japan's most scenic destinations.

hyogo.title: Big Katsura trees in Hajiri.

hyogo.title: The light of hope in the Hataganaru.

hyogo.title: Record of memory

hyogo.title: Hiyoriyama Coast.(At the time of crimson.)

hyogo.title: Hiyoriyama Coast.(A moment of bliss.)
hyogo.desc: About 20 minutes before sunrise. I never get tired of matching the sky changing every moment. It is a coast where you can see various scenery all year round.

hyogo.title: Dragon Palace and Shining beam of road.
hyogo.desc: The trail of light illuminates Dragon Palace. This view can be from Cape Omachi from late August to early September. Have a nice morning.

hyogo.title: Look up in sky

hyogo.title: Rui Treasure
hyogo.desc: It is the autumn leaves of Zuihoji Park located in Arima Hot spring, one of the most famous hot springs in Japan. Arima Hot spring is famous for the fact that Sengoku warlords and Hideyoshi Toyotomi visited it many times. A world like a painting that has been loved by the historical hot spring town still exists here.

hyogo.title: Rice terraces in Ueyama.(early autumn.)
hyogo.desc: The end of summer and the beginning of autumn. You can enjoy the seasonal scenery at the rice terraces in the mountains.

hyogo.title: Mt.Kuruhi(early autumn.)
hyogo.desc: The atmospheric layer was divided into two parts by the sky,from which sun appeared. There is a layer separate from the sea of clouds,and I think it is a very unusual landscape.

hyogo.title: Cape Omachi.(Early autumn sunrise.)
hyogo.desc: It is a view from the observation point overlooking the Hiyoriyama coast. If you want to see the morning sun and sunrise from this viewing spot,we recommend March-April and August-September.

hyogo.title: Itsukushima Shrine in Sasaura.(Mirror World.)
hyogo.desc: A water torii that stands in Sasaura Bay. The mirrored world created by the calm is beautiful.

hyogo.title: Ceiling dragon mural

hyogo.title: Rice terraces in Ueyama.(Summer sunrise.)
hyogo.desc: Beautiful morning on beautiful rice terraces.

hyogo.title: Yoshitaki Water fall.(Early autumn.)
hyogo.desc: It is a waterfall in a sacred space. Please visit once.

hyogo.title: The rising sea of clouds in the Toyooka basin.
hyogo.desc: As the sun rose fora while,the sea of clouds suddenly rose toward the sky. The sea of clouds in the basin sometimes surprises us with unpredictable movements.

hyogo.title: The sea of clouds in the Musubu.
hyogo.desc: You can't help but feel the strength and delicacy of nature as the flowing sea of clouds hits a series of mountains and begins to dance.

hyogo.title: A sea of clouds  heading for Kinosaki.
hyogo.desc: I took a bird´s-eye view of Kinosaki Bridge from the Mt.Kuruhi. It looks like the sea of clouds over the Maruyama River descends and flows toward Kinosaki.

hyogo.title: Himeji Shrine...

hyogo.title: Dance in autumn
hyogo.desc: It is the autumn leaves of Shakubuji Temple, a hidden attraction in Kobe with many sightseeing spots. The three-storied pagoda at Shakubuji Temple was one of the largest towers built during the Muromachi period. Currently, it is designated as an important cultural property. Surrounded by the surrounding mountains, there are places around the tower where the sun does not easily hit, the temperature does not rise, and the period of autumn leaves is long. 3D autumn leaves that can be enjoyed from anywhere in 360 degrees are a place of relaxation for locals.

hyogo.title: Bewitching
hyogo.desc: The bewitching cluster amaryllis is an indispensable color in autumn in Japan. The powerful blooming on the country road makes us feel the arrival of autumn.

hyogo.title: A Tendaki waterfall over the rainbow.
hyogo.desc: In the morning of autumn,strong light hangs a rainbow over the waterfall.

hyogo.title: Autumn Sarubo waterfall.
hyogo.desc: In the forest where autumn deepens. I took a picture with the waterfall as a supporting character.

hyogo.title: Autumn leaves in the Shoubu pond.
hyogo.desc: It is a pond located at an altitude of about 900m on the Ueyama plateau. The peak of autumn colors is from late October to early November.

hyogo.title: Autumn Komatagawa valley.
hyogo.desc: It is valley with Shiwagara waterfall. Looking up from the bottom of the valley,you can see this kind of scenery.

hyogo.title: View from Kinosaki Marine World.
hyogo.desc: From the Kinosaki Marine World,you can enjoy a magnificent view of the Sea of Japan. It's good to arrive a little early and have a nice morning.

hyogo.title: Stand by My
hyogo.desc: Locomotives used to run on the JR (former Japanese National Railways) Fukuchiyama Line, which was discontinued in 1986. The approximately 4.7 km of abandoned railway line that runs along the valley of the Muko River remains almost as it was at that time. It's a place where you can walk on the railroad tracks and feel like you're in the movie.

hyogo.title: The changing maiden heart and the autumn sky
hyogo.desc: It is one of the most famous temples in Tamba, the Tahoto of Kogenji Temple in autumn. Every year from early November, the entire mountain turns red. I thought it was sunny on this day, but it was a strange weather with sudden rain and wind, and after a while I could see the sunny days. The autumn leaves washed away by the rain look even more red and beautiful.

hyogo.title: Waterfall clouds in Hiyoriyama coast.
hyogo.desc: The sea of clouds that spouts toward the sea on foggy morning is a spectacular view far beyond imagination. On this day,the Earthshine moon and Venus added color,and it became a superb view. If the conditions are right,waterfall clouds can occur all year round,but I think the probability is high from late autumn to early winter. Please come and see the magnificent view of Japan that you can be proud in the world.

hyogo.title: A sea of ​​clouds dyed in the sun
hyogo.desc: It is a sea of ​​clouds in the Kuroi district in Tamba city. Seen from the top of a small mountain, there is a world of clouds. After 7 o'clock, when the sun rises from the ridge of the mountain, the dim and white world is gradually colored. It is a mysterious space for the drama created by the mountains, the sun and the clouds.

hyogo.title: A gentle morning in Seto.

hyogo.title: The fantasy world of winter.

hyogo.title: Drizzle and smoke in Oobikinohana.

hyogo.title: Kinosaki hot springs(The arrival of winter.)

hyogo.desc: It is the morning of the dam lake in Sanda City, Hyogo Prefecture. The air is cold and the water vapor on the surface of the lake is cooled, and fog can enter. In a calm lake with no waves, some people enjoy fishing early in the morning. Occasionally, anglers are talking to each other, "You can catch that. Did you catch a good one?" It's similar to the photographer's greeting, "Did you get a good shot?"

hyogo.title: A Dragon palace surrounded by fog.

It is a state when the fishing ship that was out for crab fishing returned to the port and the morning came. The fishing ship with the fog on its back was more astringent. It is a place where you can feel the strength of the soul of all historic ships.

The scenery that you just stare at in the cold air is a luxury of winter.

hyogo.title: Glittering Osaka Bay.
hyogo.desc: It is a night view from Mt.Maya. Is there as many stories as there are lights.

hyogo.title: The path of light leading to Dragon Palace.
hyogo.desc: From late summer to early autumn morning,the path of light appears in the golden world.

hyogo.title: Tenguiwa in the forest
hyogo.desc: Ozo town in Hyogo Prefecture has many places with abundant nature. The giant rock on the way up the mountain through the forest is called Tenguiwa, and it is said that there is a legend that it jumped from Rokko through Arima to Lake Senjoji in Sanda City. This Ozo town is right in the middle. The tengu may have taken a rest here and looked at the scenery.

hyogo.title: Morosugi shrine in late autumn.
hyogo.desc: It is a shrine with beautiful fallen leaves of ginkgo. The ephemeral scenery of late autumn seems to calm the mind. When I looked at the pillars of the torii as a picture frame,I saw a different view.

hyogo.title: Arikoyama inari shrine in late autumn.
hyogo.desc: The rainbow-colored autumn leaves and the vermilion torii invite visitors to another world.

hyogo.desc: The sky reflected in the pond, the pond like the sky, and the scenery like a mirror are spreading. The sky will continue forever. The world is connected.

hyogo.desc: The realm of God surrounded by fantastic snow.

Around Iwagami Shrine, the fallen leaves of large ginkgo trees begin around the beginning of December, and the end of autumn is reached. The beautiful yellow carpet may be a lost item in the fall.

hyogo.title: Jugo waterfall in the snow.

hyogo.desc: Cherry blossoms adorn the entrance to Kannabe plateau in spring. Adjacent to the elementary school,a group of old Someiyoshino trees over 90 years old are attractive. The cherry blossoms trees were planted by graduates in the early Showa period to commemorate their graduation.

hyogo.title: Izushi shrine in spring.
hyogo.desc: Cherry blossoms blooming at a historic shrine. It is a beautiful spring scene with the iconic Japanese torii gate and cherry blossoms.

hyogo.title: Weeping cherry tree at Taiunji temple.
hyogo.desc: The weeping cherry tree at Taiunji temple is more than 250 years old and has the thickest trunk in western Japan at 5.25 meters in circumference. The delicacy of thb beautiful petals and branches and the strength of the thick trunk will move visitors'hearts.

hyogo.title: Kamanbuchi.
hyogo.desc: The natural beauty of the formations created by the carving of lava tells of the long history of the earth.

hyogo.title: Carp streamers in Yoroi.
hyogo.desc: The carp streamers,which are raised only during Golden Week,swim very pleasantly in the fresh air. The other side of the red lighthouse is the open sea,and it looked like a brave backward step out to sea.

hyogo.title: The sky reflected in the Ueyama rice terraces.
hyogo.desc: The original Japan landscape seen around the time of rice planting. We photographed some of the 100 rice terraces that are carefully protected by farmers and local people. The rice terraces as a whole are very spectacular,and they are beautiful throughout the year,but the view of sky during rice planting season is especially breathtaking.

hyogo.title: Green maples at Arikoyama inari shrine.
hyogo.desc: A road leading to another world,seen in the early morning of the fresh green season.

hyogo.title: Big Katsura tree in Wachi.
hyogo.desc: A historic big katsura tree,over 1,000 years old,grows wind in the Tajima highland botanical garden. At the Tajima highland botanical garden,visitor can see a variety of plants in addition to the big katsura tree. Please visit this healing space in such a great nature where even small children can stroll safely and securely.

hyogo.title: General cedar in Fujiwa.
hyogo.desc: The hollowed-out part is reinforced with beards,but I think its appearance will generate various interpretations. In any case,it is a big tree wit a great impact.

hyogo.title: Blue blue
hyogo.desc: As I was looking at the blue sky and the blue sea, a blue train came running. The Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, which stands majestically in the piercing sky, shines blue. It was a luxurious time where I was able to see the scenery where everything was the protagonist and there were no supporting roles.

hyogo.title: Concrete dams forever
hyogo.desc: A gravity type concrete dam with a total length of 106.6 meters, a height of 42.4 meters, and a maximum depth of 35 meters. It was built from 1920 to 1920 to protect the water of citizens, and is still quietly active in the mountains of Dojo-cho, Kita-ku, Kobe City. It is beautiful, majestic, and brave.

hyogo.title: Sengari Dam
hyogo.desc: The Sengari Dam is a dam constructed in the Hatsuka River, a second-class river in the Muko River system, in Kita Ward, Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture. It is a 42.4m-high "gravity-type rubble mortar dam" managed by Kobe City, and is the largest dam in the city for the purpose of supplying water supply to Kobe City.

hyogo.title: Nishigaoka rice terraces.
hyogo.desc: The rice terraces of Nishigaoka have been selfcted as one of the 100 best rice terraces in Japan. A temple and five-story pagoda can also be seen on the mountainside across the street,providing a view of the history of man and nature. In early September,when the transition from summer to autumn takes place,after it rains,a fantastic view may be seen.

hyogo.title: Morning glow of Kinosaki hotsprings.
hyogo.desc: Passionate morning glow colors the emotional hot spring resort. The position the sunrise and weather conditions are severe,and there are only a few days throughout the year when the morning glow reflects off the river,making it a very precious sight.

hyogo.title: Waterfall clouds in Tsuiyama.
hyogo.desc: The mist flowing like a waterfall has a charm that one cannot get tired of seeing for a long time.

hyogo.title: A row of lily trees in the Naomi Uemura Memorial Museum in autumn.
hyogo.desc: It is a very nice place to feel the deeping autumn.

hyogo.title: The dawn of Tsuiyama port.
hyogo.desc: The light cast on the water by the fishing ships is a very vivid and beautiful sight. The port comes alive in November when the crab fishing season opens.

hyogo.title: Himeji castle in autumn sky.
hyogo.desc: Himeji castle seen from the zoo. The view of Himeji castle from inside the adjacent zoo is a minor but personal favorite and highly recommended. However,there is talk of the zoo being relocated,and this view may not be available in the near future.

hyogo.title: Seasons of color

hyogo.title: Morning Springs

hyogo.title: Oomori shrine in late autumn.

hyogo.title: Gingko trees in Kannabe highland.
hyogo.desc: As autumn deepens,I feel very happy when I pass by the golden tree-lined avenues.

hyogo.title: Terigashi waterfall in late autumn.

hyogo.title: Warmhearted place

It is surrounded by mountains, and although it has an image of being a little dim, the time when the sun shines on the ginkgo trees changes to a special scenery.

hyogo.title: Autumn dyed in vermillion
hyogo.desc: It is autumn leaves of Daikokuji Temple in Tanba Sasayama City. The autumn leaves dyed in vermillion seem to stand out in their beauty when they are illuminated by the sun.

hyogo.title: Wakasu-Fudo Waterfall.
hyogo.desc: This waterfall enshrines Fudo Myoo and is cherished by the local peoples. Around noon on a clear day from October to December,the sun can be seen between the rocks,and sometimes light shines through,creating a mystical space.

hyogo.title: Dragon palace shrouded in ice fog.
hyogo.desc: A winter tradition. When you see the fantastic winter scenery,you are impressed and feel the coming of severe winter on your skin.

hyogo.title: Where to wish

hyogo.title: Dragon palace on a rough sea.
hyogo.desc: It is a symbolic view of the Sea of Japan in severe winter. The height from the sea surface to the roof of the Dragon palace is more than 10 meters,but on this day,the waves were reaching far above the surface due to the heavy tides that occur only once every few years. You can safely view the scenery from the Kinosaki Marine World grounds,so be sure to experience the Sea of Japan in winter.

hyogo.title: Seiryu Waterfall.

hyogo.title: The three-story pagoda of the Emperor in the snow.

It is also confirmed that the Japanese military used it as an air-raid shelter because it was difficult to find.
